release_summary: Initial GitHub release of the existing Runes of Magic addon collection. The runtime code is unchanged from the supplied 0.11.77 bundle. This release adds organised READMEs and reproducible release packaging.
runtime_validation: No new in-game checks. All 1,382 original runtime and media files match the supplied 0.11.77 bundle byte for byte.
